title: Patch release v5.20.2
excerpt: Patch release: v5.20.2 This patch notably solves an issue where some inputs could loose their original type inside prepare_inputs_for_generation in generate , leading to problems with multimodal models. It also fixes some other issues listed on the below commits. It contains the following commits: Fix inputs dict casting in generate ( #49731 ) by @Cyrilvallez Fix zero expert gradients in bfloat16 with expert parallelism and ep_size < fsdp_size ( #49688 ) by @qgallouedec Declare the input modalities of the VLMs that report text only ( #49677 ) by @qgallouedec Avoid a host-to-device copy in eager_mask ( #49684 ) by @hmellor
